newsitem.title: USA: Urban Shopping gets contract in Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Urban Shopping gets contract in Taiwan.

text.p: Urban Shopping Centers Inc said Monday its Urban Retail Properties Co affiliate was awarded a contract for Core Pacific City, a retail, leisure and recreation center under development in Taipei, Taiwan.

The contract, which is for development management, property management, leasing and marketing services, was awarded to to Urban Retail International LLC, the international subsidiary of Urban Retail Properties.

The 2.2 million square foot center will include 20 stories, 13 above ground and seven below. Construction of the project is scheduled to begin in August and will be completed in approximately three years.

"This will be our largest and most important project to date in the Pacific Rim and it is the most significant development in the area," Matthew Dominski, president of Urban Shopping Centers, said in a statement.
In conjunction with this assignment, Urban Retail International opened an office in Taipei.
Urban Shopping Centers is a self-administered real estate investment trust that owns and manages malls.
